data.gender_notes: Tiffani is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Tiffani is a variation of the name Theophania, which means 'manifestation of God'. It is also derived from the Greek word 'theos' meaning 'god' and 'phaino' meaning 'to appear'. As a Christian name, Tiffani is a symbol of purification and renewal, drawing from both the Greek and biblical roots. The name Tiffani carries the meaning “Purifier, Goddess of the Harvest” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tiffani usually hope their child will grow to embody purifier, goddess of the harvest and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Tiffania
